data.one_liner: Adaptive desktop-style scrollbar placed on either side of the screen.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable, desktop-style scrollbar that can be positioned on any of the four sides of a scrollable widget. It supports multiple scrollbars on a single screen and automatically hides when content is not scrollable.
use_when: You need desktop-style scrollbars for Flutter apps running on desktop or web
You require placing scrollbars on custom positions like the top, bottom, or left side
avoid_when: You only need standard mobile-style physics and indicators without desktop scrollbar behavior
strengths: Supports multiple independent scrollbars on a single screen
Highly customizable colors, decorations, dimensions, and click-to-scroll speeds
Automatic hide when content is not scrollable
weaknesses: Horizontal scrollbars require a 90-degree rotation logic that affects spacing configuration
